# Installation

How to install and run HPPM **v0.26**.

**Related:** [Splash & projects](splash-and-projects.md) · [Data model](../projects/data-model.md) · [Root README](../../README.md)

---

## Windows (recommended)

HPPM ships as a single NSIS installer for **Windows x64**.

1. Download **[HPPM_v026.exe](https://github.com/ARPAHLS/hppm/releases/download/v0.26/HPPM_v026.exe)** from the [v0.26 release](https://github.com/ARPAHLS/hppm/releases/tag/v0.26).
2. Run the installer. Default location: `C:\Program Files\HPPM` — you can change this during setup.
3. Launch **HPPM** from the Start Menu or desktop shortcut. A brief branded splash appears while the app loads.
4. On first launch you see the [splash screen](splash-and-projects.md) — pick or create a project.

### SmartScreen warning

The beta installer is **not code-signed**. Windows SmartScreen may show “Windows protected your PC.” Choose **More info → Run anyway** if you trust the publisher (ARPA Hellenic Logical Systems).

### What the installer includes

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| Electron shell | Window, icon, single-instance app |
| Bundled UI | Production build of `hppm-ui` |
| API server | Reads/writes markdown and `.hppm` on your disk |
| Installer art | v0.26 sidebar and header graphics |
| Launch splash | Branded loading window while server starts |

The desktop app does **not** use File / Edit / Help menus — only the HPPM UI you see in the web build.

### Desktop data paths

| Item | Location |
|------|----------|
| Application | `C:\Program Files\HPPM` (or your chosen path) |
| Project registry | Electron **userData** folder (via `HPPM_DATA_DIR`) — not inside Program Files |
| Your projects | Wherever **you** put them — any folder you pick on splash |

Your markdown trackers never live inside the install directory unless you put them there.

---

## From source (development)

For contributors or advanced users who want to run from the repo:

```bash
cd hppm-ui
npm install
npm run dev
```

Opens **http://localhost:5173**. The dev server includes the same API middleware as desktop.

```bash
npm run build    # → dist/
npm run preview  # serve production build locally
```

### Requirements

- **Node.js** 20+ recommended
- **npm** (comes with Node)
- A modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)

---

## Desktop packaging (build your own installer)

The sibling folder `hppm-desktop` (outside this repo’s git root) wraps the UI:

```bash
cd hppm-desktop
npm install
npm run dist
```

Output: `hppm-desktop/release/HPPM_v026.exe`

This runs `hppm-ui` production build, bundles the standalone server, and converts v0.26 installer PNGs to NSIS bitmaps. See `hppm-desktop/README.md` in your checkout.

---

## Desktop vs browser dev

| Aspect | Browser / `npm run dev` | Windows installer |
|--------|-------------------------|-------------------|
| UI | Identical | Identical |
| API | Vite dev middleware | Bundled `standaloneServer` |
| Project registry file | `.hppm-projects.json` under UI root | UserData via `HPPM_DATA_DIR` |
| Offline | Yes (local server) | Yes |
| Accounts / cloud | None | None |

There is **no feature gap** between modes — only where the registry file is stored.

---

## After installation

→ Continue with [Splash & projects](splash-and-projects.md) to open your first workspace.

# Data model

How HPPM stores your work — markdown on disk, metadata in `.hppm/`.

**Related:** [The `.hppm` folder](hppm-folder.md) · [Preferences](preferences.md) · [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Priorities, trackers & tags](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md)

---

## Design principle

**Markdown is the source of truth for task text and priority sections.**  
**`.hppm/` is the source of truth for rich metadata** (issue numbers, tags, dates, links, notes, colors, audit).

If HPPM disappeared tomorrow, your `*.md` files would still open in any editor. The `.hppm/` folder adds structure HPPM needs — but your words stay in plain text.

---

## Project folder layout

```
MyProject/
├── 01-work.md              ← tracker file
├── 02-personal.md
├── 03-side-project.md
└── .hppm/
    ├── store.json
    ├── preferences.json
    └── audit.json
```

| Layer | Location | Contents |
|-------|----------|----------|
| **Trackers** | `NN-name.md` in project root | Tasks, priorities, checkboxes |
| **Project store** | `.hppm/` | Metadata, prefs, audit |
| **Machine registry** | `.hppm-projects.json` | Paths to projects on this PC |

---

## Tracker files (`*.md`)

### Naming

Trackers are markdown files in the **project root**:

- Convention: `01-area.md`, `02-personal.md`, …
- Special names like `00-revenue-sprint.md` or `99-backlog.md` are supported
- The **file title** is the first `# Heading` in the file

### Priority sections

Tasks live under second-level headings — fixed priority levels. HPPM expects **every tracker** to include all six sections, even when a section has no tasks:

```markdown
# Work

## Critical
- [ ] **Ship release** — finalize installer

## Very High
- [ ] **Review PR**

## High
…

## Med
…

## None
…

## Done
- [x] **Old task** — completed item
```

| Priority | Markdown section |
|----------|------------------|
| Critical | `## Critical` |
| Very High | `## Very High` |
| High | `## High` |
| Med | `## Med` |
| None | `## None` |
| Done | `## Done` (completed checkbox tasks move here) |

See [Priorities, trackers & tags](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md).

### Task line format

```markdown
- [ ] **Title** — optional description after em dash
- [x] **Completed title**
```

- **Bold** text before ` — ` becomes the **title** in the UI
- Checkbox `[ ]` / `[x]` drives open vs done
- Changing priority in HPPM **moves the line** to the correct `##` section in the file

### What stays in markdown

| In markdown | In `.hppm` store only |
|-------------|----------------------|
| Title & description text | Issue number (`#308`) |
| Priority section (via heading) | Tags |
| Open / done checkbox | Start & due dates |
| Which tracker file | Links to other issues |
| | Notes field |
| | Impact & effort scales |

You can edit markdown externally; click **Refresh** in the header to reload from disk.

---

## Issue numbers

Each task gets a stable **issue number** (e.g. `#308`) stored in `.hppm/store.json`.

- Assigned when the task is first seen / created
- Used in links (`#42`), search (`id:42`), and audit entries
- Shown in every view and the task drawer

---

## Fingerprints

HPPM identifies tasks internally with a **fingerprint**: `filename::normalized-task-text`.

If you edit task text in markdown, the fingerprint may change — HPPM reconciles via store metadata and resolves the current line when you complete, move priority, or move tracker from the UI. Avoid renaming task text drastically without using HPPM if you rely on links.

---

## New tasks

When you create a task in HPPM:

1. A new markdown line is inserted at the **top** of the chosen priority section
2. Store metadata is written (number, tags, dates, etc.)
3. An audit entry `task.create` is logged

---

## External editing

| Safe | Caution |
|------|---------|
| Edit title/description in markdown or task drawer | Deleting lines manually may orphan store entries — prefer **Delete task** in drawer |
| Toggle `[ ]` / `[x]` | Renaming files breaks tracker references until refresh |
| Add new `- [ ]` lines manually | Duplicate text may confuse fingerprints |

Always **Refresh** after bulk external edits.

---

## Privacy

No cloud sync. No telemetry. Data never leaves your machine unless **you** copy it.

---

# Search Header search field — query tasks across the active view with field prefixes and free text. **Related:** [Header bar](header.md) · [Filters](filters.md) --- ## Basics - Placeholder: **“start typing”** - Combines with [funnel filters](filters.md) — both must match - Empty search = no search constraint - Result hint appears when query is active (e.g. `12 of 249`) Search indexes: issue number, title, description, tracker name, priority, tags, dates, notes, links, status keywords, and more. --- ## Field prefixes Use `field:value` syntax. Multiple fields are **AND**ed. Quotes for spaces: `title:"quarterly review"`. | Field | Aliases | Matches | |-------|---------|---------| | `tag:` | `tags:` `label:` `labels:` | Task tags | | `tracker:` | `file:` `area:` | Tracker file / area name | | `priority:` | `pri:` `p:` | Priority level or slug | | `due:` | `deadline:` | Due date (ISO or partial) | | `start:` | `from:` | Start date | | `notes:` | `note:` | Notes field | | `link:` | `links:` | Linked issue `#n` | | `id:` | `num:` `number:` | Issue number | | `status:` | | `open` · `done` · `overdue` | | `title:` | | Title text only | | `text:` | `desc:` `description:` | Full description | ### Examples ``` tag:job priority:critical tracker:personal overdue due:2026-07 status:open id:42 link:308 title:"taktile interview" text:newsletter ``` --- ## Free text tokens Words without `field:` search the **full index**: ``` newsletter gemini "exact phrase" #42 → issue 42 or link to 42 42 → same overdue → past due, still open done → completed tasks open → not completed ``` All free tokens must match (**AND**). --- ## Combined queries ``` tag:outreach priority:high status:open tracker:01-work due:2026-07-20 ``` --- ## Interaction with Show completed Search can find **done** tasks with `status:done` or `done` token even when [Show completed](show-done.md) is off — behavior follows the underlying filter pipeline in App. --- ## Analytics & audit search The **Analytics** and **Audit trail** modals have **separate** text search fields for their datasets — same syntax spirit but scoped to audit events. See [Analytics](../tools/analytics.md) and [Audit trail](../tools/audit-trail.md). --- [← Filters](filters.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Show completed →](show-done.md)

name: Sync labels

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/labels.yml"
      - ".github/workflows/sync-labels.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  sync:
    name: Sync labels from labels.yml
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Sync labels
        uses: EndBug/label-sync@v2
        with:
          config-file: .github/labels.yml
          # Keep GitHub native priority labels and any manual extras
          delete-other-labels: false
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Desktop / installer
description: Electron shell, launch splash, NSIS installer, packaging, SmartScreen
title: "[Desktop]: "
labels: ["area:desktop"]
body:
  - type: dropdown
    id: surface
    attributes:
      label: Surface
      options:
        - Launch / splash window
        - Main window chrome (frame, title, single-instance)
        - Installer (NSIS wizard / EULA / art)
        - Install paths / Start Menu / shortcuts
        - SmartScreen / unsigned binary warning
        - "HPPM_DATA_DIR / userData / project registry"
        - "Build packaging (hppm-desktop dist)"
        - Other
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: input
    id: installer
    attributes:
      label: Installer or build
      description: e.g. `HPPM_v026.exe`, or `npm run dist` from hppm-desktop
      placeholder: HPPM_v026.exe
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: input
    id: os
    attributes:
      label: Windows version
      placeholder: Windows 11 24H2, x64
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: what
    attributes:
      label: What went wrong?
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: steps
    attributes:
      label: Steps
      placeholder: |
        1. Run installer
        2. Launch HPPM
        3. …
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: dropdown
    id: install_location
    attributes:
      label: Install location (if relevant)
      options:
        - Default Program Files
        - Custom path
        - "Portable / unpacked win-unpacked"
        - N/A

  - type: checkboxes
    id: extras
    attributes:
      label: Observed
      options:
        - label: SmartScreen warning
        - label: Splash shows black / missing image
        - label: Splash stuck / never closes
        - label: App won’t start / server timeout
        - label: Wrong EULA / garbled text

  - type: textarea
    id: logs
    attributes:
      label: Logs (optional)
      description: Anything from a terminal `npm run dist` or Event Viewer — no secrets.
      render: text

name: Server / API
description: Node API routes, audit writes, analytics aggregation, standalone server
title: "[Server]: "
labels: ["area:server", "needs repro"]
body:
  - type: dropdown
    id: area
    attributes:
      label: Area
      options:
        - Task routes (toggle / move / text / delete / meta)
        - Tracker / tag management routes
        - Audit log write or read
        - Analytics aggregation
        - Project open / create / registry
        - Standalone server / Electron bundling
        - Other
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: input
    id: endpoint
    attributes:
      label: Endpoint or module (if known)
      description: e.g. `POST /api/task/delete`, `server/markdown.ts`
      placeholder: optional

  - type: dropdown
    id: run_mode
    attributes:
      label: Run mode
      options:
        - Vite dev middleware
        - Packaged desktop (`standaloneServer`)
        - Both / not sure
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: request
    attributes:
      label: Request / action
      description: What the UI did, or a redacted request body shape (no real paths/secrets).
      render: text
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: response
    attributes:
      label: Response / error
      description: Status, message, stack excerpt.
      render: text
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: disk_effect
    attributes:
      label: Disk effect (optional)
      description: Did markdown / store / audit change incorrectly?
      render: markdown

  - type: input
    id: version
    attributes:
      label: HPPM version / commit
      placeholder: v0.26
    validations:
      required: true

---

HPPM — High Priority Project Manager

Your work stays in plain markdown on your machine. HPPM is the desk you spread it on — drag cards on a board, stretch dates on a timeline, and notice what’s asking for you today.

--- ## What this is Most project tools ask you to upload your life to someone else’s server, pay monthly to access your own notes, and sit through upsells while you try to finish a simple task. People end up juggling Jira, Asana, Notion, and half a dozen tabs — distracted, subscribed, and never quite in control of their data. **HPPM is not that.** It is a **local-first project manager** for people who want clarity without the noise. Your work lives in plain markdown files on your disk — readable, portable, yours. HPPM adds the views: kanban, timeline, analytics, audit trail, and a priority picker that helps you decide what actually matters today. **What it is not:** a cloud service, a social network, an ad surface, or a subscription trap. No accounts, no telemetry, no “upgrade to Pro” pressure. Nothing leaves your machine unless you put it there. **Why we built it:** project management should feel like a calm workspace, not a landlord. You should own your files, your history, and your focus — with tools that are deep enough to run real work, but honest enough to stay out of the way. **Who it is for:** builders, operators, privacy-minded professionals, and anyone exhausted by SaaS sprawl — people who want one serious desk for their priorities, offline, auditable, and free of rent. If the internet disappears tomorrow, your trackers are still on your drive. That is the whole idea. --- ## Overview HPPM reads numbered markdown tracker files (e.g. `01-area.md`) on your disk. Metadata, audit history, and settings live under `.hppm/` in each project folder. No account, no sync server, no vendor lock-in. The **Windows app** ships as a single installer; you can also run from source for development. **v0.26** adds a desktop launch splash, tracker moves from the task drawer, and more reliable priority/complete actions on all trackers. ![Overview dashboard](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_dashboard.png) --- ## Quick start ### Windows 1. Download **[HPPM_v026.exe](https://github.com/ARPAHLS/hppm/releases/download/v0.26/HPPM_v026.exe)** from the [v0.26 release](https://github.com/ARPAHLS/hppm/releases/tag/v0.26). 2. Run the installer (default: `C:\Program Files\HPPM`). 3. On first launch, pick a workspace folder or create a project from a template. > Installer is not code-signed yet — Windows SmartScreen may warn until a certificate is added. ### From source ```bash npm install npm run dev ``` Opens [http://localhost:5173](http://localhost:5173). ```bash npm run build # production build → dist/ npm run preview # preview the build ``` Desktop packaging lives in the sibling `hppm-desktop` folder (`npm run dist` → `HPPM_v026.exe`). --- ## Documentation Full user guide: **[docs/README.md](docs/README.md)** | Section | Topics | |---------|--------| | [Getting started](docs/getting-started/installation.md) | [Install](docs/getting-started/installation.md) · [Splash & projects](docs/getting-started/splash-and-projects.md) | | [Projects & data](docs/projects/data-model.md) | [Data model](docs/projects/data-model.md) · [`.hppm` folder](docs/projects/hppm-folder.md) · [Preferences](docs/projects/preferences.md) · [Templates](docs/projects/templates.md) | | [UI chrome](docs/ui/header.md) | [Header](docs/ui/header.md) · [Filters](docs/ui/filters.md) · [Search](docs/ui/search.md) · [Footer](docs/ui/footer.md) | | [Views](docs/views/overview.md) | [Overview](docs/views/overview.md) · [Table](docs/views/table.md) · [Kanban](docs/views/kanban.md) · [Timeline](docs/views/timeline.md) · [Neural](docs/views/neural.md) · [Fruits](docs/views/fruits.md) | | [Tasks](docs/tasks/task-drawer.md) | [Task drawer](docs/tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Priorities, trackers & tags](docs/tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md) | | [Tools](docs/tools/analytics.md) | [Analytics](docs/tools/analytics.md) · [Audit trail](docs/tools/audit-trail.md) | | [Reference](docs/reference/themes.md) | [Themes](docs/reference/themes.md) · [Languages](docs/reference/languages.md) · [Tips](docs/reference/tips-marquee.md) | See also **[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)** for version history. --- ## Views Six top-level views, each with sub-modes where noted. | View | Sub-modes | What it does | |------|-----------|--------------| | **Overview** | — | Open / done / overdue stats, priority & tracker bars, 7-day activity snapshot, link to analytics | | **Table** | **Sheet** · **List** | Spreadsheet grid (default) or grouped list; sticky header on scroll; column visibility via gear; eye menu switches sub-view | | **Kanban** | **Priority** · **Trackers** | Drag cards between columns; writes priority / tracker back to markdown | | **Timeline** | **Priority** · **Trackers** · **Calendar** | Gantt lanes or month calendar; drag bars for start/due; week / month zoom | | **Neural** | **Tracker** · **Priority** · **Tags** · **Links** · **Free** | Force-directed graph of tasks, links, and clusters; layout persists per project | | **Fruits** | — | Ranked “what next” view by priority, impact, effort, and due dates; signature themes add a short intro animation | ### Table — sheet & list ![Table view](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_table_sheet.png) ### Timeline — Gantt & calendar ![Timeline](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_timeline.png) ### Neural — graph layouts ![Neural graph](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_neural.png) ### Fruits — priority picker ![Fruits view](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_fruits.png) Signature themes (Chrome, Militech, Void, Umbra, Majestic) add themed splash overlays and a staged intro animation on Fruits. --- ## Analytics & audit - **Analytics modal** — time-series of creates, completes, reopens, and moves; tracker breakdown; hover mini-tooltip per bucket (localized in all seven languages) - **Audit trail** — period selector, action / tracker / priority / tag filters, search, export (JSON / CSV / TXT) ![Analytics](src/assets/screens/hppm_default_analytics.png) --- ## Tasks & project management - **Global filters** — trackers, priorities, tags, impact, effort, text search; funnel badge counts active filters; persist across views; Kanban/Timeline hide unfiltered columns/lanes when tracker or priority filters are active - **Task drawer** — inline edit title and description (markdown sync); colored **tracker pill** dropdown to move tasks; notes with save confirmation; start/due, links, impact/effort, tags; **delete task**; keyboard shortcuts when open; resizable panel - **Create & manage** — new tasks, trackers, tags; recolor / rename tags; fixed priority levels with theme-aware colors - **Drag-and-drop** — kanban columns, timeline bars, table reorder where supported - **Show completed** — top-bar toggle for list views (Overview always shows both open and done) - **Keyboard shortcuts** — `/` focus search, `1`–`6` switch views, `n` new task, `?` full cheat sheet (seven languages); Table/Fruits row browse with drawer open — see [Keyboard & interaction](docs/reference/keyboard.md) --- ## New project templates **Blank** plus **36 persona seeds** — resort, warehouse, real estate, financial audit, construction, clinic, content studio, city services, fundraising, software sprint, legal, events, teacher, yacht charter, plumber, restaurant, photographer, graduate student, wedding planner, retail shop, nonprofit field, fitness coach, vet clinic, landlord, keynote speaker, streamer squad, influencer, shift worker, indie founder, account executive, family caregiver, film crew, musician, e-commerce solo, electrician, relocation. Task dates are relative to the project creation day. --- ## Themes Fourteen themes in the footer palette picker — city-inspired palettes plus five signature themes: | Theme | Character | |-------|-----------| | **Default** | Soft lavender light — the classic HPPM look | | **Default Dark** | Same pastel accents on charcoal | | **Athens** | Cream marble, Santorini sea blue | | **Moscow** | Warm beige, burgundy, autumn wood | | **Shenzhen** | Cool glass tech, crisp blue on steel | | **Tokyo** | Night violet, cyber glow | | **Geneva** | Clean white, alpine red | | **Paris** | Cold steel night, wine accent | | **Abu Dhabi** | Desert cream, oasis green & gold | | **Chrome** | Mirror-finish light — blush, peach, pale gold | | **Militech** | Tactical green terminal, amber readouts | | **Void** | Pitch black — color as a soft ghost | | **Umbra** | Moonlit dark — lavender and purple pastels | | **Majestic** | Medieval light — gold, bronze, marble warmth | ![Chrome kanban](src/assets/screens/hppm_chrome_kanban_loading.png) --- ## Languages UI chrome in **English**, **Greek**, **Russian**, **Chinese**, **Japanese**, **French**, and **Arabic** (RTL layout). Your task titles, tracker names, and tags stay exactly as you typed them. --- ## Footer tips Contextual tips in the footer marquee (toggleable per project). Short hints for filters, views, keyboard flows, and theme-specific behavior. # Show completed The header checkbox that controls visibility of **done** tasks in list views. **Related:** [Header bar](header.md) · [Filters](filters.md) · [Overview](../views/overview.md) --- ## Control Header → **Show completed** checkbox (label toggles between show / hide done). --- ## When ON Done tasks appear in: | View | Behavior | |------|----------| | **Table** | Done rows visible | | **Kanban** | **Done** column populated | | **Timeline** | Completed bars shown | | **Neural** | Done nodes included | | **Fruits** | Done tasks excluded from ranking buckets regardless | --- ## When OFF (default) Done tasks are **hidden** from the views above. Kanban **Done** column may appear empty. --- ## Overview exception **Overview** always reports open, done, and overdue counts on stat cards — independent of this toggle. The dashboard is meant to show the full picture. --- ## Persistence HPPM remembers this setting for each project. --- ## vs markdown Done section Completing a task moves its markdown line to `## Done`. The toggle only controls **UI visibility** — it does not change files. --- [← Search](search.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Create menu →](create-menu.md)

# Overview Dashboard home — stats, charts, and gateway to analytics. **Related:** [Header bar](../ui/header.md) · [Analytics](../tools/analytics.md) · [Filters](../ui/filters.md) ![Overview dashboard](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_dashboard.png) --- ## Opening Overview - Click the **HPPM logo** - Select **Overview** in the view nav (grid icon) - Often the default when you open a project --- ## Stat cards Top row — animated count-up on first load: | Card | Shows | |------|-------| | **Open** | Open task count | | **Done** | Completed count | | **Critical** | Open critical priority | | **Very High** | Open very high | | **Overdue** | Open tasks past due | | **Trackers** | Number of tracker files | Respects [filters](../ui/filters.md) and [search](../ui/search.md) for open/overdue; done total reflects filtered scope. **Does not** respect [Show completed](../ui/show-done.md) for done counts — Overview always shows done stats. --- ## Charts ### By priority (open) Horizontal bars — open tasks per priority level. ### By tracker (top 12) Horizontal bars — which tracker files hold the most open work. ### This week Mini time-series — **created** vs **completed** over the last **7 days** (from audit/store timestamps). --- ## Open analytics Button opens full [Analytics modal](../tools/analytics.md) — longer periods, series toggles, drill-down. --- ## Click-through Stat cards and bars are informational — click tasks in other views or use Table/Kanban for action. Overview does not embed the task drawer on chart click (unlike Analytics drill-down). --- ## Empty / filtered state If filters hide everything, cards show zero. Widen filters or clear search to recover. --- [← Footer](../ui/footer.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Table →](table.md)

# Table view Spreadsheet and grouped list — two sub-views for scanning many tasks. **Related:** [Header bar](../ui/header.md) · [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Show completed](../ui/show-done.md) --- ## Sub-views | Mode | Icon menu | Best for | |------|-----------|----------| | **Sheet** | Eye menu → Sheet | Sortable grid, many columns, bulk scan | | **List** | Eye menu → List | Grouped by tracker, inline complete | ![Table — sheet view](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_table_sheet.png) Preference key: `views.tableSubview` → `sheet` | `list` --- ## Sheet mode Spreadsheet-style grid with resizable columns. ### Columns | Column | Content | |--------|---------| | `#` | Issue number | | **Priority** | Level + color | | **Tracker** | File / area | | **Start** | Start date | | **Due** | Due date | | **Impact** | Scale | | **Effort** | Scale | | **Tags** | Tag chips | | **Links** | `#n` references | | **Task** | Title + description | ### Column gear menu ### Column resize - Drag column border to resize - Double-click border to **auto-fit** width Column layout saves to browser `localStorage` (`hppm-table-prefs-v2`) — not in `.hppm/`. ### Scrolling The **eye menu** toolbar and **column header row** stay fixed while sheet rows scroll — sort and resize headers remain visible on long lists. --- ## List mode Tasks **grouped under tracker headings**. Each row: - Issue number, priority, title - **Complete** checkbox inline - Click row → [task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) Compact for triage within one tracker at a time. --- ## Interactions | Action | Result | |--------|--------| | Click row | Open task drawer | | Sort (sheet) | Click column header | | Complete (list) | Toggle checkbox → markdown + audit | Respects [filters](../ui/filters.md), [search](../ui/search.md), [show done](../ui/show-done.md). ### Keyboard When the drawer is closed: **↑ / ↓** move row highlight · **Enter** open task · **`v`** toggle sheet / list · **Esc** clear highlight. With the drawer open: arrows still move highlight · **Enter** switches to the highlighted task · **Esc** closes the drawer (highlight stays). Clicking elsewhere clears highlight. --- [← Overview](overview.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Kanban →](kanban.md)

# Tips marquee Short hints in the footer that rotate while you work. **Related:** [Footer](../ui/footer.md) · [Preferences](../projects/preferences.md) --- ## Marquee The center of the footer shows brief tips — filters, views, drag-and-drop, saving notes, and similar. They change on a timer. To turn the marquee off, click the **i** icon in the footer and disable it. HPPM remembers your choice for each project. --- ## Tips info (`i` icon) | Control | What it does | |---------|----------------| | **Marquee on/off** | Show or hide scrolling tips | | **Show All** | Open the full list of tips | | **Keyboard shortcuts** | Open the `?` cheat sheet (same as pressing **?** in the app) | --- ## Show All Opens a panel with every tip. Each entry has: - A **short line** (what you see in the marquee) - A **longer explanation** when you expand it - **Highlight** — hover a tip to dim the rest of the app and point at the relevant button or area Use this when you are learning the app or forgot where a feature lives. --- [← Languages](languages.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Keyboard →](keyboard.md)

# Neural view Force-directed graph of tasks — five layout modes for exploring structure. **Related:** [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Links](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md#issue-links) ![Neural graph](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_neural.png) --- ## Layout modes | Layout | Clusters by | Best for | |--------|-------------|----------| | **Tracker** | Tracker / area | See which file owns which work | | **Priority** | Priority level | Urgency landscape | | **Tags** | First tag | Tag gravity | | **Links** | Link graph | Dependency chains | | **Free** | Physics float | Ungrouped exploration | Switch via layout dropdown. HPPM remembers your last choice for each project. --- ## Nodes - **Color** = priority level - **Label** = `#issue` number - Size uniform; cluster positioning varies by layout --- ## Edges - **Links mode** — edges between linked issues (`links` in store) - **Tags / tracker** — cluster ring edges for grouping - **Free** — minimal cluster edges --- ## Interactions | Input | Action | |-------|--------| | **Click node** | Select → open [task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) | | **Drag node** | Reposition (session layout; resets on layout change) | | **Drag empty canvas** | Pan | | **Scroll wheel** | Zoom | --- ## Performance Large projects (200+ visible tasks) may feel dense — combine [filters](../ui/filters.md) to narrow graph. Respects [show completed](../ui/show-done.md), filters, search. --- [← Timeline](timeline.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Fruits →](fruits.md)

# Timeline view Gantt lanes and calendar — schedule by priority, tracker, or month grid. **Related:** [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Show completed](../ui/show-done.md) ![Timeline Gantt](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_timeline.png) --- ## Lane modes | Mode | Lanes | Use case | |------|-------|----------| | **Priority** | Critical → Done | See schedule by urgency | | **Trackers** | One lane per tracker | See schedule by area | | **Calendar** | Month grid | Day-based planning | Switch via eye menu or lane selector. Preferences: `views.timelineLane`, `views.timelineZoom` --- ## Zoom (Gantt modes) | Zoom | Visible range | |------|---------------| | **Week** | ~7-day window | | **Month** | ~30-day window | Toggle **WEEK** / **MONTH** in timeline header. HPPM remembers your last choice for each project. When [tracker or priority filters](../ui/filters.md) are active, Gantt modes hide lanes that do not match the selection. --- ## Gantt interactions | Action | Effect | |--------|--------| | **Drag bar** | Move start/due together | | **Drag bar edge** | Resize start or due | | **Drag bar vertically** | Change priority or tracker lane (mode-dependent) | | **Click bar** | Open [task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) | Dates stored in `.hppm/store.json` — not in markdown lines. --- ## Calendar mode ![Calendar month grid](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_timeline_calendar.png) Month grid (`TimelineCalendar`): | Control | Action | |---------|--------| | **◀ ▶** | Previous / next month | | **Today** | Jump to current month | | **Day cell** | Tasks due that day as pills | | **Click pill** | Open task drawer | | **Day popover** | Quick list for busy days | Tasks without due dates do not appear on calendar. --- ## Empty state Message when no dated tasks: set **due dates** in task drawer to populate timeline. --- ## Filters Only tasks with dates show bars (Gantt) or calendar pills. [Filters](../ui/filters.md) and [search](../ui/search.md) still apply. --- ## Keyboard **`v`** — cycle lane mode: priority → trackers → calendar. --- [← Kanban](kanban.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Neural →](neural.md)

# Kanban view Drag-and-drop boards — by **priority** or by **tracker**. **Related:** [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Priorities](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md) · [Data model](../projects/data-model.md) ![Kanban board](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_kanban.png) --- ## Sub-modes | Mode | Columns | Eye menu label | |------|---------|----------------| | **Priority** | Critical · Very High · High · Med · None · Done | Default | | **Trackers** | One column per tracker file | Trackers | HPPM remembers your last choice for each project. When [tracker or priority filters](../ui/filters.md) are active, Kanban hides columns that do not match the selection (priority mode also shows **None** when filtered). ![Kanban — trackers mode](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_default_kanban_trackers.png) --- ## Cards Each card shows: - Issue `#`, tracker label - Title (+ description on larger cards) - Tags, impact/effort chips, due date - Theme-aware priority colors Click card → [task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md). --- ## Drag and drop | Drag | Effect | |------|--------| | **Within column** | Reorder cards (persisted in `kanbanColOrder`) | | **Across columns (priority mode)** | Changes task **priority** → moves markdown section | | **Across columns (tracker mode)** | Moves task to another **tracker file** | All moves write to markdown + audit (`task.move`). --- ## Done column When [Show completed](../ui/show-done.md) is on, **Done** column fills with completed tasks. When off, column may appear empty. --- ## Empty columns Drop zone hint: **“drop here”** on empty columns. --- ## Signature themes Chrome, Militech, Void, Umbra, and Majestic show themed splash watermark behind board — see [Themes](../reference/themes.md). ![Chrome kanban](../../src/assets/screens/hppm_chrome_kanban_loading.png) --- ## Keyboard **`v`** — toggle priority / trackers (same as eye menu). --- [← Table](table.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Timeline →](timeline.md)

# Create menu Header **+** button — create tasks, trackers, and tags. **Related:** [Header bar](header.md) · [Task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) · [Priorities, trackers & tags](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md) --- ## Menu items | Item | Opens | |------|--------| | **New task** | Create task modal | | **New tracker** | Create tracker modal | | **New tag** | Create tag modal | --- ## New task | Field | Required | Notes | |-------|----------|-------| | Title | Yes | Becomes bold text in markdown | | Detail | No | After ` — ` in markdown line | | Tracker | Yes | Which `*.md` file | | Priority | Yes | Which `##` section | | Tags | No | Adds to store | | Start / Due | No | ISO dates in store | | Impact / Effort | No | Scales in store | Date pickers portal above the modal so the calendar is not clipped. On save: 1. Markdown line inserted at **top** of priority section 2. Issue number assigned 3. Audit `task.create` logged --- ## New tracker | Field | Notes | |-------|-------| | Name | Becomes `# Title` and filename | | Color | Tracker chip color in UI | Creates a new `NN-name.md` with all standard priority sections (`## Critical` through `## None`, plus `## Done`) — empty except for the `# Title` heading. Audit `tracker.create`. See [Manage trackers](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md#manage-trackers). --- ## New tag | Field | Notes | |-------|-------| | Name | Lowercase normalized | | Color | From 8-color palette | Adds to global tag registry. Use on tasks via drawer or create task form. See [Manage tags](../tasks/priorities-trackers-tags.md#manage-tags). --- ## After creation - **Task** → opens in current view; click to open [task drawer](../tasks/task-drawer.md) - **Tracker** → appears in filter menu and kanban tracker mode - **Tag** → available in tag inputs and filters --- [← Show completed](show-done.md) · [Docs index](../README.md) · [Footer →](footer.md)
